results.title: Fans banned from filming ‘slurred’ interview
results.description: Hayden Panettiere said she wanted to “leave the world a better place than [she] found it” in her last interview before her tragic death at 36.

results.title: ‘My Hero Academia,’ ‘Kill Blue’ & More Stream Free on Viki for a Limited Time
results.description: Rakuten’s Viki — a top streaming platform for content out of Asia — is lifting the paywall on 25 Japanese, Chinese and Korean animation titles for a limited time, including global hits like My Hero Academia. The first batch is available until September 21, with the second dropping August 19 and available until September 28.
